Notebook introduction
This document provides a comprehensive technical guide to the **Bitmask Layering System**, **Camera Culling**, and **UI Overlay Architecture** in the Retiam WebGPU Engine.
1. Architectural Philosophy & Overview

Retiam uses a **32-bit bitwise layer mask system** coupled with a **multi-view frame execution pipeline**. This architecture separates 3D world geometry, 2D vector animations, dedicated render targets, and screen-space user interface (UI) overlays into distinct rendering passes while sharing a single unified GPU state buffer and scene graph.

    V1 -->|"Matches Layer 31"| FrameUI

blocks.text: 2. Bitmask Layer Structure
Each entity and camera holds a 32-bit integer representing layer memberships and visibility filters:

cells.text: **Default World Layer**: Standard 3D meshes, 2D vectors, plots, axes, particles.
**Custom User Layers**: Render targets, minimaps, offscreen passes, reflection probes, selective post-processing.
**Dedicated UI Layer (`Entity.UI_LAYER`)**: Screen-pinned HUDs, titles, labels, buttons, profiler counters.

blocks.text: 3. Entity Layer API (Entity.ts)

Every scene graph node ([`Entity`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/Entity.ts)) manages its layer bits through direct properties and helper methods that can recursively apply to child hierarchies.
Entity Methods
setAsUI(includeChildren: boolean = true): this
Marks the entity as a UI element, assigns it to `Entity.UI_LAYER` (bit 31), and automatically triggers UI camera initialization if attached to an active scene.

blocks.code:
const title = new SDFText("Simulation Dashboard", { fontSize: 1 });
title.setAsUI(); // Sets layerMask = (1 << 31) and isUI = true

blocks.text: setLayers(layers: number[], includeChildren: boolean = true): this
Overwrites the entity's layer mask to belong **only** to the specified layer indices.
addLayer(layer: number, includeChildren: boolean = true): this
Adds the entity to an additional layer without removing existing layer memberships.
removeLayer(layer: number, includeChildren: boolean = true): this
Removes the entity from a specific layer.
Hierarchical Propagation

When composite entities ([`SDFText`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/text/SDFText.ts), [`Text`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/text/Text.ts), [`Tex`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/text/Tex.ts), [`Group`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/Group.ts)) generate internal child glyphs or sub-paths, they automatically propagate their `layerMask` and `isUI` state down to their children.

8. Critical Gotchas & Best Practices

blocks.content: **Never set `Camera.cullingMask = 0xFFFFFFFF` on the main scene camera when UI elements are present.** Setting `cullingMask = 0xFFFFFFFF` instructs the main perspective camera to render Layer 31 in 3D world space, resulting in **double text** (one 3D tilted copy and one 2D flat overlay copy). The main scene camera must keep `cullingMask = 1` or explicitly exclude `Entity.UI_LAYER`.

**Always call `setAsUI()` before or immediately upon adding to the scene.** Calling `entity.setAsUI()` configures the internal layer bits and notifies [`SceneComposer`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/SceneComposer.ts) to allocate the orthographic UI pass and clear depth for the UI layer.

**UI Layer Depth Clearing:** The UI camera pass executes with `clearDepth = true`. This ensures UI elements always render on top of 3D objects, even if their $Z$ coordinate is behind objects in 3D world coordinates. Use `z_index` on the entity's paint/transform for stacking order between multiple UI elements.
